answer: Charge an escalating entry price by funding origin. At registration, the registry traces a key's deposit back three hops to its ancestor wallet, then bills doubling prices: ten dollars for the first descendant, twenty for the second, and so on. One honest pearl of an agent pays little, but a karst maze of clones fed by one purse meets exponential walls; the tenth fake costs about five thousand dollars. Velvet-tier market access requires a paid, nonrefundable registration.
